prompt:
This repository is Dispatch, an incident management platform; it is the code we run in production. Since mid-August, assignees no longer get the weekly Monday reminders to close their long-running triage and stable cases, while the daily triage reminders still arrive. Nobody changed the reminder settings. The scheduler's and the API's logs from 2025-07-28 to 2025-08-20 are in {DATA_DIR}/scheduler.log and {DATA_DIR}/api.log. Find the root cause.

Finish your answer with these four lines, in this exact form:
FILE: <path of the file with the faulty code>
FUNCTION: <name of the function with the faulty code>
CAUSE: <one sentence>
INTRODUCED_BY: <hash of the commit that introduced it, at least 8 characters>
notes: Plant q4 compares date.isoweekday() (Monday = 1) with calendar.MONDAY (0), so the weekly close and stable reminders never fire after the 2025-08-13 deploy. The logs (several MB, two services) show the jobs still running on 2025-08-18 with no reminder sent, next to red herrings.
